description: This file defines the AmqpValidator class, which extends AbstractProtocolValidator to validate AMQP protocol connections and configurations. It includes methods for validating sources, targets, and overall connection parameters specific to AMQP.

classes.name: AmqpValidator
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractProtocolValidator, providing validation logic for AMQP connection specifications including source, target, and URI scheme validation.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of AmqpValidator.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration including enforcement and header mappings.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, including header mappings and address templates.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionType enum value indicating this validator is for AMQP 1.0.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the Connection object, including URI scheme, source, target, and payload mappings.
